title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Other Insurance on the Building from a BizFlood Statement of Values
content:
Apportionment note for building payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the amount of other insurance on the building, read from the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) that schedule the building's address.

**Rule.** The other insurance on the building is settled as follows: when that BizFlood policy schedules the building's address and a value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the building limit set by that endorsement, the value endorsement in force being, of the value increase and the value decrease endorsed for the location, the one that took effect later among those that took effect on or before the date of loss, an increase and a decrease taking effect the same day being settled by the one recorded later, and by the increase when both were recorded the same day; when that BizFlood policy schedules the address and no value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the building value on its statement of values for that address; otherwise there is none.

The BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy that schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program.

## Records read

The BizFlood statement of values entry for the address (its building value) and the BizFlood value increase and value decrease endorsements for that address — each with its effective date, recorded date and building limit.

## Which value endorsement is in force

| Value endorsements effective on or before the date of loss | Endorsement in force |
|---|---|
| none | no value endorsement — the statement of values building value applies |
| an increase only | the increase |
| a decrease only | the decrease |
| both, different effective dates | the one with the later effective date |
| both, same effective date, different recorded dates | the one recorded later |
| both, same effective date and same recorded date | the increase |

An endorsement taking effect after the date of loss is not in force on the date of loss.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Statement of values building value 400,000; value increase to 450,000 effective 1 May; date of loss 10 June: other insurance 450,000.
- The same, with the increase effective 1 July: other insurance 400,000.
- No BizFlood policy schedules the address: no other insurance.
